name: Josef Gregorian
summary: Josef Gregorian is a Forsaken tailoring trainer found working in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. He guides ambitious Horde tailors seeking to weave enchanted fabrics, providing expertise and directing them toward specialized garments.

sections.title: Weaver of the Magic Quarter
sections.body: Amid the dim alchemical lanterns and damp vaults of the Magic Quarter, Josef Gregorian maintains the fine craft of tailoring for the Forsaken and their Horde allies. While life in the subterranean kingdom has turned cold, cloth-working remains vital for warlocks, mages, and priests who channel raw energies through woven fibers. Gregorian serves as a dependable instructor in the capital, ready to teach foundational patterns and to stitch the first robes of young mages who bring him the right materials.

faq.q: Where can I find Josef Gregorian?
faq.answer: Josef Gregorian is located in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, practicing and teaching the tailoring craft among the city's casters and scholars.

faq.q: What role does Josef Gregorian serve in the Undercity?
faq.answer: He is a tailoring trainer who teaches sewing recipes and techniques to Horde crafters. He also stitches the first robes of young mages sent to him by Anastasia Hartwell.

faq.q: What quests does Josef Gregorian offer?
faq.answer: Gregorian takes part in a mage quest chain: Anastasia Hartwell sends young mages to him with linen cloth and Dalaran mana gems taken in Silverpine (Gathering Materials), and he stitches them a set of Lesser Spellfire Robes (Spellfire Robes).

angles.text: For Horde clothiers, Josef Gregorian is a prime contact in Lordaeron, offering instruction to tailors and stitching robes for young mages who bring him the materials.
Gregorian demonstrates that despite death and undeath, the delicate arts of human tailoring survived the fall of Lordaeron to serve the new Forsaken society.
